scope: New Claude Sonnet 5.5 judge requests only. Preserve the executed cross-family protocol, prior zero-request budget stops, and all unknown-charge reservations.
change: For verified inline single-frame images no larger than 1024 pixels on either edge, reserve 8192 visual tokens per image instead of the generic 40000. Keep text UTF-8 bytes plus 2048, maximum applicable prompt/cache-write/output tiers, output limit, image fees, and the existing margin unchanged.
solver_eligibility_amendment: Gemini shipping may use a separately recorded continuation of its first-pass supplemental run after a pre-dispatch budget stop on the next logical request. Require the original acknowledged calls to be inherited, unchanged settings and original turn/tool limits, no physical replay of the blocked logical request, and a frozen continuation request hash matching its first new call. This is continuation of the same attempt, not a fresh repeat. Other failed Gemini solver outputs remain ineligible.
continuation_eligibility: Only an original budget_limited record with zero calls, zero batches, zero unresolved calls and no physical reservation can get a separately stored continuation. Existing invalid or completed judgments are preserved.
priority: NPV and GMP first, then remaining prespecified Sol and eligible first-pass Gemini artifacts if shared headroom allows.
comparison_limit: A reservation-method amendment changes dispatch eligibility, not the prompt, rubric, images, output-token budget or model verdict. No accuracy or acceptance claim follows.
